forms.other: Create an independent configuration-capable Go project

Create an independent configuration-capable Go project.

Usage:
  fathomry new <name> --module <module-path> [options]

Options:
  --directory <parent>         Existing destination parent (default .)
  --framework-version <ver>    Exact framework module version; required for development builds
  --configuration local|remote Default source kind (default local)
  --provider viper|nacos       Provider for that kind (default viper/nacos respectively)
  --environment-source <name>=<kind>/<provider>
                              Override one declared environment; repeat for other environments
  --default-locale en|zh-Hans  Generated project default language (default en)
  --sdk-bundle <directory>     Explicit version-bound local SDK bundle
  --lang <locale>             Creation-tool output language only

Environments are development, test and production. For example, keep local
Viper for development and use --environment-source production=remote/nacos.
Generated dotenv examples require explicit --env-file selection at runtime.
Generation creates source only, without downloads, Git initialization or service access.
